verdict.rationale: Natural-language commands are the core interaction model: users ask ChatGPT to generate or edit images, draft and revise files, and delegate work to subagents. The same plain-language requests drive the browser, Computer Use, and voice coordination of tasks (start, check progress, change direction), and annotations let users point at content and say what to change. Community users describe extensive hands-on conversational use, though not of the newer agentic controls. Missing for 10: evidence that product settings and configuration can be changed by natural language (these appear to use slash commands and the settings UI), and independent hands-on corroboration of the agentic browser and Computer Use controls.
